```sql
SELECT o.country, round(sum(o.net_revenue_eur), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_orders AS o
JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_day = o.order_date_local
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' 
  AND d.calendar_year = 2025
GROUP BY o.country
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC
```

```sql
SELECT o.region, round(sum(o.net_revenue_eur), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_orders AS o
JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_day = o.order_date_local
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' 
  AND d.fiscal_year = 2027 
  AND d.fiscal_quarter = 1
GROUP BY o.region
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC
```

```sql
WITH order_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        o.region,
        o.order_date_local,
        o.net_revenue_eur,
        o.gross_revenue_eur,
        r.amount_eur
    FROM analytics.fct_orders AS o
    JOIN analytics.fct_refunds AS r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
      AND o.order_date_local >= '2025-02-01'
      AND o.order_date_local < '2026-02-01'
),
refund_rate_by_country AS (
    SELECT 
        o.region,
        SUM(r.amount_eur) AS total_refunded,
        SUM(o.gross_revenue_eur) AS total_gross_revenue,
        ROUND(SUM(r.amount_eur) * 1.0 / SUM(o.gross_revenue_eur), 4) AS refund_rate
    FROM order_revenue AS o
    JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_day = o.order_date_local
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = 2026
    GROUP BY o.region
)
SELECT 
    region,
    refund_rate
FROM refund_rate_by_country
ORDER BY refund_rate DESC
LIMIT 1
```
